tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
all other terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: As an outsourcing agency, details of the previous outsourcing of HR services of at least 1000 employees to Central/ State Government/ Semi-Government organizations in 03 years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 (attachment of certificate issued by an officer not below first grade).
The manpower organization/agency should be a registered organization, The operative societies should be registered with the Act. (Registration).
ESI Registration certificate and last 3 years paid challans copy
EPF Registration certificate and last 3 years paid challans copy
Tenderer should submit the copy issued by Chartered Accountants for an average of any two financial years in the last 3 years for Rs.25,00,000(Twenty Five Lakhs)
